10.1083/jcb.140.4.853.title: Titin extensibility in situ: entropic elasticity of permanently folded and permanently unfolded molecular segments
10.1083/jcb.140.4.853.used_for: Physiological I-band extension: tandem-Ig domains remain folded while the PEVK segment behaves as an unfolded entropic chain over the studied range.

10.1038/s41467-024-46957-7.title: Myosin-binding protein C regulates the sarcomere lattice and stabilizes the OFF states of myosin heads
10.1038/s41467-024-46957-7.used_for: Fast skeletal MyBP-C context: C-zone association, approximately three molecules per approximately 43 nm repeat, flexible N-terminal/middle regions, and effects on lattice and myosin OFF-state regulation. Does not provide exact human N2A-compatible coordinates.

10.1038/s41586-023-06690-5.title: Structure of the native myosin filament in the relaxed cardiac sarcomere
10.1038/s41586-023-06690-5.used_for: Conditional cardiac M-band limitation context only: M1 was absent from the averaged reconstruction, M-band-associated protein density remained partly unresolved, and expected flexible crosslinks were averaged out. No exact coordinate is transferred into the skeletal N2A model.

10.1038/s41586-023-06691-4.title: Cryo-EM structure of the human cardiac myosin filament
10.1038/s41586-023-06691-4.used_for: 6 A cryo-EM of the human cardiac C-zone. Source of the MEASURED titin azimuthal arrangement (3 sectors x TA/TB pair, two radial shells), the 3-crown quasi-helical array and its unequal inter-crown rotations [32,16,72] deg, and the backbone-vs-envelope diameter distinction. Supersedes the prior UNKNOWN declaration in sarcomere.json:unknowns[Azimuthal arrangement].

PDB:8G4L.title: Human cardiac myosin filament C-zone (atomic model)
PDB:8G4L.used_for: Coordinates measured directly for context_measurements.json. Composition confirmed: 78 myosin heavy chains, 18 ELC, 18 RLC, 6 titin, 3 cMyBP-C.
PDB:8G4L.caveat: 3-fold symmetry was IMPOSED during reconstruction; CARDIAC, while this project's declared scope is the skeletal N2A isoform.

PDB:6KN7.title: Human cardiac thin filament in the calcium-free state
PDB:6KN7.used_for: Coordinates measured for actin helical parameters: rise 2.755 nm, twist -166.628 deg, crossover repeat 37.091 nm, CA envelope 8.235 nm. Basis for admitting the thin-filament long-pitch twist while deferring subunit-level depiction.
PDB:6KN7.caveat: The complex carries cardiac troponin subunits, but the measured actin entity is explicitly alpha-skeletal actin; the geometry transfer is direct for this project's skeletal scope.
